ch1.title: Microservices Architectures
ch1.challengeText: Decoupling rigid monoliths while ensuring high availability and asynchronous communication between services.
ch1.solutionText: Designing REST APIs using Spring Boot, NestJS, and FastAPI, choosing the optimal framework based on workload, and optimizing database transactions.

ch2.title: Odoo ERP Development
ch2.challengeText: Adapting a standard ERP to highly complex business logic, without compromising core system stability or future maintainability.
ch2.solutionText: Custom Odoo module development. Optimizing ORM queries, customizing critical workflows like billing and inventory, and modifying views via QWeb.

ch3.title: RPA & Process Automation
ch3.challengeText: Reducing manual operational workload, eliminating data-entry errors, and synchronizing older legacy systems that lack APIs.
ch3.solutionText: Developing UiPath bots and Python/Bash scripts for the reliable automation of back-office flows, smoothly orchestrating disconnected legacy systems.

stack.coreDesc: Designing complex business logic and fast, scalable, well-documented RESTful APIs.
stack.dbDesc: Relational modeling, indexing, and optimization of complex queries at scale.
stack.odooDesc: Business process analysis, custom module creation, flow management, and advanced ORM customizations.
stack.rpaDesc: Developing robotic process automations to streamline business workflows and eliminate repetitive tasks.
stack.cloudDesc: Application containerization and Linux infrastructure management for secure, reproducible deployments.
stack.workflowDesc: Software lifecycle management in Agile environments, ensuring continuous integration and team collaboration.
